Beast Masters
Author: Derek Chestnut (dbchest)
​
What is Beast Masters?
A collection of javascript plugins which modify and / or extend the default functionality of the engine.
What is Beast Masters' high concept?
A highly polished plugin package that allows developers to make their game(s) function like a popular Pokemon game.
Which game mechanics will be implemented?
The game mechanics featured in Pokemon Fire Red and Leaf Green will serve as the backbone of Beast Masters.
Where can I find more information about Beast Masters?
There is additional information about this project at its official web page.
**under construction, link will be made available when construction is complete.
How can I support Beast Masters?
That would mean so much! The support section of the official web page has information on how you can contribute to Beast Masters.
**under construction, link will be made available when construction is complete.
Author's Notes
Community support is encouraged.
Requests for additional features will be taken into consideration.
**If you are excited for Beast Masters, spread the word and provide links to this page!
**Click
here
to watch a video demonstrating the current state of the Battle System.
**Click below to download the working project file.
https://www.dropbox.com/s/hlpzmtyxqq00bjs/Beast Masters (2).zip?dl=0

posts.author: dbchest

the idea was to avoid unnecessary programming and keep integration as simple as possible; i accomplished that by cropping each image to 144 x 80 and aligning it to the top of a 144 x 144 square (the default face dimensions). by following this design, developers can simply use the face picker in the database like normal for selecting their beast's faces.
the graphics above only appear to be wider than normal. each face is still 144 x 144.

posts.author: dbchest
posts.body:
now that IGMC 2017 is reaching its conclusion, i am excited to announce that the production of Beast Masters will now resume!
for those of you who are unaware of what Beast Masters is; Beast Masters is a collection of plugins which modify the engine's default behavior to emulate desirable gameplay mechanics featured in pokemon fire red and pokemon leaf green.
**refer to this thread's initial post for more information.
for those of you who have been tracking the development of Beast Masters; i want to thank you for your continued interest!
the future of Beast Masters:
i have been contacted by a few members with questions and comments regarding the finer details about Beast Masters. in response to these inquiries, i have decided to launch a patreon campaign so that i may provide a better user experience for those of you who will be using the Beast Master plugin package in your future projects.
Spoiler:
information regarding the upcoming patreon campaign
the patreon campaign will be launched on or around 11/21/2017. the purpose of the patreon campaign is to provide a better user experience to developers who are developing with the Beast Masters plugin package, by accompanying each plugin with additional quality content, which has been designed and created to target the individual needs and interests of the patron.
if you wish to be contacted with information about the launch of this campaign, or you want a sneak peek at some of the rewards i will be offering to my patrons, you may either pm me here at the forums, or you may express your interest right here in Beast Masters' official development thread.
i am very excited to be moving forward with this project, and i hope that you are excited too!

posts.author: dbchest
posts.body:
@Nutty171
yes, of course. the entire plugin package will be available to this community free of charge upon completion.
meanwhile, patrons will have special access to each plugin as they become available, for familiarization and implementation into their personal projects; this will assist developers by ensuring they are not overloaded with material all at once. for patrons only, these updates will be accompanied by the working project file and thorough documentation. additional learning material, such as pro-tips on implementation and usage, as well as video tutorials regarding best practices and even the javascript itself will be optional to patrons, as well as a few other really cool rewards.
basically, granting Beast Masters a small patronage will result in greatly reducing the learning curve that will come with developing with the plugin package, by placing everything you need to succeed at your fingertips, while helping to ensure that i have the time and resources to bring you the best possible content.

What is the exact text of the license you will use?
The open source community for programming tends to use the
MIT
for new projects.  Older projects tend to use the
GNU
license (which it is why it skewing the graph below).
Artistic licenses (for game assets) tend to lean more towards licenses from
Creative Commons
.
NOTE: The question on license applies to what you
add
to the game assets that come with RPG Maker MV -- they of course have their own license which you cannot change.
​
Thanks,
Joy Diamond

posts.author: dbchest
posts.body:
good evening, beast masters! i did a little restructuring regarding the way beasts are initialized and managed in the back-end to allow for a dynamic developer experience, so i felt it appropriate to provide some insight for those of you who are interested in using Beast Masters to create a catch 'em, train 'em, battle 'em style game.
the old data structure
Code:
party <- beasts
the new data structure
Code:
party <- actors <- beast stones <- beasts
this new data structure better demonstrates the actual relationship between actor and beast, and by maintaining the default data structure between the party and its actors we now
have the option
of creating a game that utilizes a full party of actors who are all capable of catching and training beasts. the primary benefit of this new data structure is overall game depth, in my opinion; incorporating more party members
can translate
into deeper storytelling to establish greater user engagement.
i am excited about the new direction i am heading in with beast masters but please note the decision to choose whether to have a single trainer or several trainers is entirely up to you as the developer.

i realize there are a few members in this community who have interest in Beast Masters, so i wanted to take a moment to clear up some the confusion about what is going on with the project and my intentions moving forward with it.

i just wanted to reassure those of you with continued interest in Beast Masters that THIS PROJECT HAS NOT BEEN ABANDONED and work will resume when time permits. if any of you guys have any questions or comments, please do not hesitate to ask.
